description: This file contains functions and variables related to managing cgroup paths and hierarchies in a Linux environment, including path initialization, root path determination, and applying cgroup configurations.

methods.name: initPaths
methods.description: Initializes and returns a map of subsystem names to their respective cgroup paths for a given cgroup.

methods.name: tryDefaultCgroupRoot
methods.description: Attempts to determine the default cgroup root path based on filesystem and mount point checks.

methods.name: rootPath
methods.description: Finds and returns the path to the root of the cgroup hierarchies, using cached value or parsing mount info.

methods.name: subsysPath
methods.description: Constructs the path to a specific cgroup subsystem, handling absolute and relative inner paths.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Creates the specified cgroup path and assigns a process to it.
